name: kdentrix-backend
description: K-Dentrix Dental Clinic – Full Stack Backend

scripts.build: mkdir -p public && (git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Kng08/kdentrix-frontend.git temp-frontend 2>/dev/null && cd temp-frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && cp -r temp-frontend/build/* public/ && rm -rf temp-frontend || echo "Frontend clone failed, using existing public folder") && npm install
